text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During training, Daitaku Helios became the 
wind! Too bad she doesn't pace herself and 
often exhausts herself. Her Trainer-poo 
tries to get her riding a good wave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one involved back then was 
K.S.Miracle, the sweet girl☆ rooming with 
Daiichi Ruby. Caring for Ruby, who was 
still getting her body in shape—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios suggests they all go for a 
light run. Lining up alongside her faves, 
it turns into the absolute best time ever!
